comparison.objective: Calibrate a tool tip by holding it on one reference point from four orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision point contact while changing tool orientation and maintaining a fixed TCP.
comparison.success_condition: Four one-second contact poses with prescribed lean, inter-pose angular separation, stillness, and mount integrity.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision alignment, but this record tests multi-orientation TCP calibration rather than adjustment-and-locking followed by impact-response tuning.
